description: A 3D arcade browser game using Three.js where the player pilots a cardboard airplane to defend against enemies.

structure.index.html: Main HTML file. Loads stylesheets and provides the container for the WebGL canvas and UI.
structure.style.css: Game styling, UI overlays, menus, and typography.

libs/.three.core.min.js: Three.js internal core logic (required by the module).

js/.main.js: Game loop initialization and orchestration. It coordinates managers instead of holding logic directly.
js/.scene.js: Three.js scene, camera, and renderer setup.

core/.GameState.js: Centralized global state for the game (score, energy, level, etc.).

managers/.InputManager.js: Handles mouse, touch, and keyboard events.
managers/.LevelManager.js: Handles environment updates, level transitions, and resets.
managers/.UIManager.js: Handles DOM interactions, buttons, settings, and start menus.

objects/.Airplane.js: Player character model and animation logic.
objects/.Weapons.js: Weapon systems, bullets, and firing mechanics.
objects/.Enemies.js: Enemy spawning, enemy types (basic, boss), and collision logic.
objects/.BackgroundBattle.js: Background battle effect with alien and allied fighters, lasers, and a nuclear explosion effect.
objects/.Sea.js: The rotating planet/sea that acts as the ground.
objects/.Sky.js: Skybox logic, clouds, sun, and moon.
objects/.Forest.js: Generates low-poly procedural trees on the ground.
objects/.Mountains.js: Generates low-poly procedural mountains in the background.
objects/.Grass.js: Generates low-poly procedural grass and vegetation.
objects/.Rocks.js: Generates low-poly procedural rocks on the ground.
objects/.Mothership.js: Boss enemy mothership with 5000 HP, multiple attack phases, and death ray.
objects/.VictoryScene.js: 3D victory scene with parked airplane, dancing pilot, Dulce the dog, banner plane, trees, flowers, butterflies.

ui/.hud.js: In-game HUD rendering logic (score, health, energy).

conventions.modules: Uses ES6 modules heavily. main.js exposes THREE to window.THREE to support modules that might assume global scope.
conventions.colors: Materials use hex colors from js/utils/colors.js.
conventions.lighting: Uses Three.js physically correct lighting. Intensities are relatively high (e.g. 3.0 - 4.5) to achieve the vibrant 'colorinche' look.
conventions.renderer: Configured with THREE.LinearSRGBColorSpace to maintain bright, legacy-style colors despite modern color management.

important_rules: Whenever you modify the responsibility of a file, update this AI_GUIDE.json.
If adding new 3D objects or scenery, ensure they are integrated smoothly without breaking the global ColorManagement rules set in scene.js.
All JS files must have a JSDoc block comment at line 1 summarizing what they do.
